findings.title: Non-concurrent index on high-write table
findings.evidence: The migration creates an index without CONCURRENTLY on payments.transactions.
findings.recommended_action: Use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY and validate the execution plan in staging.

findings.title: Rollback plan is missing
findings.evidence: The scenario declares rollback_provided=false and provides no rollback script.
findings.recommended_action: Attach a tested rollback or documented compensating action before production approval.

findings.title: Database connection pool is above the review threshold
findings.evidence: Connection pool usage is 86%, above the 80% DBA-review threshold.
findings.recommended_action: Review database capacity with a DBA and avoid concurrent high-impact changes during peak load.

findings.title: Staging validation is incomplete
findings.evidence: The release context states that representative staging validation has not been completed.
findings.recommended_action: Test the migration using representative data and capture runtime, locking, and rollback evidence.

findings.title: Required DBA approval is missing
findings.evidence: The change targets production and dba_approval=false.
findings.recommended_action: Obtain explicit approval from an authorised DBA or change approver before any production execution.

recommended_actions: Use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY and validate the execution plan in staging.

Obtain explicit approval from an authorised DBA or change approver before any production execution.

findings.title: Production CPU request was reduced
findings.evidence: CPU request was reduced from 500m to 100m (80% reduction).
findings.recommended_action: Restore the approved CPU request or provide load-test evidence, staging validation, and SRE approval.

findings.title: Load-test evidence is missing
findings.evidence: CPU request was reduced but load_test_evidence_available=false.
findings.recommended_action: Run representative load tests before reducing production CPU requests.

findings.title: Staging validation is incomplete
findings.evidence: The release context declares staging_validation_completed=false.
findings.recommended_action: Validate the release in staging and capture resource usage, error rate, and latency evidence.

findings.title: Readiness probe is missing
findings.evidence: The deployment has no readiness probe, so traffic may be sent to an unready application instance.
findings.recommended_action: Add a readiness probe that verifies the application can safely receive production traffic.

findings.title: Liveness probe is missing
findings.evidence: The deployment has no liveness probe, so failed workloads may remain running without automatic recovery.
findings.recommended_action: Add a liveness probe that detects unrecoverable application failure.

findings.title: Rolling update can make all replicas unavailable
findings.evidence: replicas=3 and max_unavailable=3, allowing full service outage.
findings.recommended_action: Set max_unavailable below the replica count and use a controlled rolling update or canary rollout.

findings.title: Rollback plan is missing
findings.evidence: rollback_plan_provided=false and no rollback command is available.
findings.recommended_action: Document the stable version, rollback command, and health-check observation period before deployment.

findings.title: Required SRE approval is missing
findings.evidence: The change targets production and sre_approval=false.
findings.recommended_action: Obtain explicit approval from an authorised SRE, platform engineer, or change approver before production execution.

findings.title: Anonymous public data access is enabled
findings.evidence: azurerm_storage_account.paymentreceiptprod sets allow_blob_public_access=true.
findings.recommendation: Disable anonymous public access or provide an approved security exception with compensating controls.

findings.title: Public network access allows all networks
findings.evidence: azurerm_storage_account.paymentreceiptprod enables public network access with network_default_action=Allow.
findings.recommendation: Disable public network access and use a private endpoint or an approved restricted firewall allowlist.

findings.title: Minimum TLS version is below TLS 1.2
findings.evidence: azurerm_storage_account.paymentreceiptprod sets minimum_tls_version='TLS1_0'.
findings.recommendation: Set the minimum TLS version to TLS1_2 or later.

findings.title: Required customer-managed encryption key is absent
findings.evidence: azurerm_storage_account.paymentreceiptprod requires a customer-managed key but none is configured.
findings.recommendation: Configure an approved customer-managed key and record the required key-management approval.

findings.title: Mandatory production resource tags are missing
findings.evidence: azurerm_storage_account.paymentreceiptprod is missing tags: CostCenter, Owner.
findings.recommendation: Add Environment, Owner, and CostCenter tags before production execution.

findings.title: Required security approval is missing
findings.evidence: security_approval_present=false for this production IaC change.
findings.recommendation: Obtain explicit approval from an authorised security or platform approver before any Terraform apply.

findings.title: Rollback and recovery plan is missing
findings.evidence: rollback_plan_present=false for a change affecting data exposure, networking, or encryption.
findings.recommendation: Document the previous secure configuration, rollback steps, owner, validation checks, and observation period.

orchestration_findings.title: Consolidated production change approval is missing
orchestration_findings.recommendation: Obtain explicit approval from the accountable production change approver after all specialist remediation is complete.

orchestration_findings.title: Consolidated release rollback plan is missing
orchestration_findings.recommendation: Document an integrated rollback plan covering database, Kubernetes, and IaC changes, including owners and validation.
